title: Hunt: Walk Out of the Folder
story: A teammate shipped this code. Read it like an attacker and tap every risky line.

tests.label: Find every risky line, then pick the fix

hints: Look for places where outside input reaches something powerful.
socratic: Compare your result with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what attack does this code allow?

why_lines.6: The file name comes from the URL and is not checked.
why_lines.7: A name like ../../etc/passwd climbs out of the uploads folder.

fix.question: How do you stop it?
options: Resolve the full path and confirm it is still inside UPLOADS
fix.why: Check where the final path really points, after .. is resolved.
